### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Attribute temporal or aggravating factors (e.g., "worsens in the afternoon") only to the specific symptoms explicitly linked in the transcript.
[A-Section]: State only the explicitly identified causes for diagnoses as provided by the doctor; do not infer specific etiologies (e.g., "due to low intake") from subsequent treatment plans or general discussions, nor introduce potential causes or differential diagnoses not explicitly discussed. Clearly differentiate between patient-reported symptoms and objective physical exam findings; do not misclassify exam findings as symptoms. Ensure precise reporting of exam findings, including specific characteristics (e.g., "on expiration") only when explicitly stated.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: For diagnoses, state only the explicitly identified causes as provided by the doctor. Do not infer specific etiologies (e.g., 'due to low iron intake' for anemia) from subsequent treatment plans, dietary advice, or general discussions; only include direct causal statements from the provider.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Accurately reflect the frequency and duration of symptoms as stated by the patient; do not introduce qualifiers (e.g., "occasional") if not explicitly mentioned or if they contradict the patient's description of persistence.
[P-Section]: List only the explicitly stated purposes for follow-up appointments; do not add inferred or general objectives (e.g., "discuss progress on lifestyle changes") if not specified by the provider.
